description: This file contains FastAPI route handlers demonstrating various response models, response validation, and handling of different response content types. It also includes test cases validating responses and OpenAPI schema generation.

classes.name: BaseUser
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing a basic user with a name.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A Pydantic model extending BaseUser by adding a surname.

classes.name: DBUser
classes.description: A Pydantic model extending User with a password hash.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model with item properties 'name' and 'price'.
